body.message:
We currently have a fully furnished 1-bedroom apartment available at Upside Living, Business Bay.

Rate: AED 8,500 per month
Security Deposit: AED 2,000 (refundable)
Booking: Monthly basis, calculated as 30 nights
Unit: 1-bedroom, without Burj View

You can view the property details and photos here:

Upside Living – 1 Bedroom Apartment

https://www.airbnb.com/rooms/1568692016246188830

For a long-term booking, the first month's rent, last month's rent, and security deposit are required in advance. The remaining rent can be paid monthly.

Please note that the rate is subject to availability until the booking is confirmed.

Thank you, and we look forward to hearing from you.
